newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil bolsa reshuffles Bovespa, IBX indexes.
newsitem.headline: Brazil bolsa reshuffles Bovespa, IBX indexes.

text.p: Brazil's Sao Paulo Stock Exchange said in a statement that it has reduced by one to 48 the number of issues that make up its Bovespa index of most-traded shares.
The bolsa said it had removed preferred shares of Alpargatas and Cimento Itau from the index, but added Minas Gerais state-owned power firm Cemig's common stock.
The Sao Paulo bourse also said in a separate statement that it had altered the make-up of its broader 100-share IBX, or Brazil Index.
It added Lorenz preferred shares and Brahma and Coelba common, but scratched from the list Alpargatas, Cia Hering, Ipiranga Distribuidora and Polar preferred and Unibanco common.
The bolsa said it left unchanged its Electrical Energy Index of 10 most-liquid power stocks.
